CommunityApplications.Profile:
Remuxarr cleans up a Sonarr/Radarr media library for better direct-play compatibility, without ever re-encoding video. It remuxes containers (MKV to MP4 when every track inside is already compatible), drops audio and subtitle tracks outside your chosen languages, and fixes broken or missing language metadata. Everything is done by lossless stream copy, so the video data itself is never touched.
This repository maintains one application, Remuxarr. Support is handled through GitHub Issues, linked below.
